source_text: Si formatus fuerit, dabit animam pro anima. Perfectior doctrina maiorem exigit custodiam. Scandalum paruulorum — mola.
pass_a_gloss: If formed he-will-have-been, he-will-give soul for soul. More-perfect teaching greater exacts custody. Scandal of-little-ones — millstone.
pass_b_english: [[If the child is formed, life is given for life >> Bible:Exodus 21:23]]. Fuller teaching demands fuller care. Scandalizing little ones earns a millstone.
